# Website development checkpoint

## Evidence guard follow-up

Snapshot guards now raise explicit errors rather than using assertions that Python
can disable with `-O`. Source manifest identity, failed stage receipts, evidence
hashes, re-aggregated label outcomes and denominator reconciliation are checked
before writing a snapshot. This is integrity checking, not cryptographic provenance
certification; stage manifests themselves are not signed.

Verification: 131 tests passed, including tampered evidence, duplicate outcome
groups, negative/noninteger counts, denominator mismatch and optimized-Python guard
execution. The actual snapshot regenerated successfully under `python -O`.
Root, CSS, JavaScript and JSON returned HTTP 200 on localhost:8766; JavaScript syntax
check passed. These checks do not replace browser visual/interaction QA.

The authored static Site lives in `site/dist`; static configuration is in
`site/.openai/hosting.json`. No hosted Site was registered or deployed: requested
full-site acceptance and real-data publication review are still incomplete.
Do not mistake the local research slice for B28 or B30 completion.

Current routes are hash-routed overview, evidence, portfolio anatomy, transitions,
observed loss, models/controls, methods, reproduction/delivery, Excel Library and
vintage/lifecycle. They expose actual verified development results and explicit
unsupported-claim boundaries. The Portfolio page includes the verified 102-row
origination profile by Relief segment with separate count/principal shares.
Forecast, causal strategy, collections uplift and
public publication remain gated.

`scripts/build_site_snapshot.py` exports only bounded aggregate evidence from the
selected completed pipeline. Labels, monthly portfolio rows, transition rows and
loss aggregate are re-aggregated from hash-checked Parquet and compared to stored
summaries. Audit findings and monthly data hashes are checked.
No loan identifier, raw record, account credential or private filesystem path is exported.
The data snapshot stays gitignored. This is not a public disclosure/privacy certification.

Validation: JavaScript syntax check; HTTP200 root; local asset/snapshot availability.
No claim of completed browser interaction, visual, mobile or accessibility QA.
Preview server binds127.0.0.1 only, port8766. The former static-only server has been
replaced by `crsl.research_server`: a fixed static allowlist plus two hash-checked
private workbook endpoints. It does not expose repository/raw-data directories.
Browser opening was queued by the desktop app; this is not proof the user saw the page.

Hosting is deliberately deferred until the complete intended release and publication
boundaries are validated. A static config without project_id is not a published Site.
Excel Library now has a private 15-sheet workbook, lazy-loaded preview, sheet
selection, search, sorting, pagination and actual download. The Vintage sheet includes
the validated aggregate competing-risk table; the Transitions page and `05_Transitions`
sheet include the verified segment mart; and Loss includes the observed B18 gate.
The delivered HTTP bytes
match the workbook/preview SHA256. Public-safe workbook publication and clean-browser
interaction acceptance remain incomplete. See `workbook-development.md`.


## Executive-dashboard redesign — 2026-09-12

The recruiter-facing visual layer has been rebuilt without changing the underlying evidence contract. The previous hash-routed research-console presentation was replaced by a single narrative dashboard with anchored sections and a reduced navigation surface. The redesigned flow is:

`Overview → Story → What I built → Analytics → Models → Evidence → Excel`

Key UI changes:

- dark risk-analytics visual system with responsive glass/card hierarchy;
- executive hero and KPI layer;
- recruiter storytelling and one-sentence project framing;
- architecture and capability mapping;
- SVG-based monthly portfolio charts;
- interactive vintage matrix;
- transition heatmap with estimand toggle;
- observed-loss component bridge;
- model/readiness roadmap;
- governance/evidence section moved later in the reading flow so the project can be understood quickly without hiding limitations.

The frontend still reads the validated `site/dist/data.json` snapshot, keeps `frontend_recompute = false`, and does not expose raw loan identifiers or prediction rows. No model metric, expected-loss amount, causal strategy impact, or cross-vintage result was invented for the redesign.

Implementation files: `site/dist/index.html`, `site/dist/style.css`, `site/dist/dashboard-fixes.css`, and `site/dist/dashboard.js`. The private data snapshot remains gitignored and is regenerated by the existing snapshot pipeline.
